value.summary: This pull request converts the host loop from a single-turn-per-step model to a round model where `step` returns multiple turns and one `next_state` for all of them. Each turn in the round is projected against the same transcript and run in series; the state is committed once every turn is appended. The loop correctly handles the round's `turns` vector, the new `next_state` field, and the per-round pinboard bound.  The code is consistent with the looked-up definitions and looks sound to merge.
